local_metadata.text:
This dataset, collected from a crop field in Bangladesh, includes 1,603 wheat leaf images across 
five disease categories: BlackPoint (303), FusariumFootRot (250), HealthyLeaf (250), LeafBlight (400), 
and WheatBlast (400). Data augmentation was applied to generate 1,000 images per class, resulting in a 
balanced augmented dataset of 5,000 images. The augmented data is split into training (70%), validation (20%), 
and testing (10%) sets. Organized into Original, Augmented, and Splitted datasets, this resource is ideal for 
wheat disease classification and deep learning applications in agriculture.

Here is a well-structured directory tree based on the mentioned dataset:
